messages.subject: memory leak patched in auto-dif
parts:
There was a memory leak in the base class
I implemented:

op_vector_vari

It was holding onto a std::vector that itself
allocated memory. So I replaced the
std::vector<vari*> with an array vari**
that I allocated in our arena.

I had to rewrite a bit of the log_sum_exp
function, which was the only subclass that
depended on it.

I've been considering a completely different design
for var/vari that removes the virtual chain()
function but requires an extra 8 bytes per
expression argument to store the adjoint
multiplier (so it's a wash for unary
operators and gets worse with higher arity).
It'll be faster -- tight loop rather than
virtual function applications.

- Bob
